translations.web: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.
translations.bsb: Consequently, whoever resists authority is opposing what God has set in place, and those who do so will bring judgment on themselves.
translations.kjv: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
translations.asv: Therefore he that resisteth the power, withstandeth the ordinance of God: and they that withstand shall receive to themselves judgment.
